svg.title: About Muhammad Reyhandhani
svg.desc: I build web applications and APIs, primarily backend and also frontend. Currently learning system design, scalable architecture, DevOps, and CI/CD. Open to full stack projects and open source collaboration. Official Arsène artwork from Persona 5 Strikers accompanies the profile in a different pose from the banner.
svg.text: I build web applications and APIs. Backend work
is where I spend most of my time, but I also
I like digging into how an application works,
from the interface to the database, and making
the code easier to maintain along the way.
Full stack projects and open source.
